The right view is the Side view (YZ plane), showing the L-profile of the base and upright panel. The world frame is defined as X (width, left-right in Front view), Y (depth, front-back in Side view), and Z (height, bottom-top in Front view).

The four openings are subtractive features that pass completely through the upright_panel.
edit_rules: Changing base_thickness moves the bottom of the upright_panel relative to the base.
Changing panel_thickness changes the depth of the openings.
Changing panel_width or panel_height requires repositioning the openings to maintain relative spacing.
Changing opening dimensions requires ensuring they do not intersect each other or the panel boundaries.
